projects.title: AI-powered Contract Processing Platform
projects.shortDescription: An AI-assisted workflow that extracts structured information from real estate contracts, presents it for human validation and synchronises confirmed data with CRM systems.

sections.label: The challenge
sections.description: Real estate transactions involve purchase contracts, broker agreements and supporting addenda, with essential information scattered across documents. Manually transferring property details, financial terms and deadlines into a CRM is time-consuming and prone to errors.

sections.label: My contribution
sections.description: I developed the document upload and extraction workflow, integrated Claude for AI-assisted processing, and built the interface for reviewing and editing extracted information. I also implemented data persistence with Supabase and contract-specific field mappings for CRM synchronisation.

sections.label: How it works
sections.description: Users upload the documents associated with a transaction. The platform analyses them together and extracts information such as property details, purchase price, key dates, contact information and broker compensation.

sections.label: Key technical challenges
sections.description:
• Processing multiple documents: combining information from related PDFs while preserving rules about which document can supply each field.
  • Handling uncertainty: returning missing values explicitly and providing field-level confidence scores.
  • Keeping compensation data distinct: separating buyer-broker compensation, seller-paid compensation and seller concessions.
  • Mapping data to the CRM: translating a consistent extraction format into the appropriate custom fields for each contract type.

sections.label: Product value
sections.description: The platform brings document processing, human review and CRM updates into one workflow, reducing repetitive data entry while keeping users in control of the information submitted.

sections.label: Technologies
sections.description: Nuxt.js · Node.js · Supabase · Tailwind CSS · Claude API · CRM APIs

projects.title: Dynamic Form Builder
projects.shortDescription: A configurable form platform that enables non-technical users to create dynamic forms with reusable components, conditional logic, and automatic CRM synchronisation.

sections.label: The challenge
sections.description: Different workflows require different information, but creating and maintaining a separate form for every use case introduces repetitive development work. Teams need a flexible way to configure forms without relying on a developer for every change.

sections.label: My contribution
sections.description: I developed a configurable form system with reusable input components, conditional field visibility and validation. I connected form submissions to CRM workflows and used Supabase to persist form configurations and submission data.

sections.label: How it works
sections.description: Users configure forms using reusable components and define conditions that determine which fields appear, and to which CRM field should the submitted data map to. As someone completes a form, the interface adapts to their answers and validates the relevant inputs. Submitted information is mapped to the corresponding CRM fields and synchronised automatically.

sections.label: Key technical challenges
sections.description:
• Reusable field components: supporting different input types through a consistent configuration and component interface.
  • Conditional logic: keeping field visibility and validation aligned as answers change.
  • Reactive form state: coordinating updates between nested components, dependent fields and validation rules.
  • CRM integration: translating configurable form submissions into the field structure expected by the CRM.

sections.label: Product value
sections.description: The platform gives teams more control over their data collection workflows, reduces repetitive form development and removes the need to manually transfer submissions into the CRM. Reusable components provide a consistent experience across different forms.

sections.label: Technologies
sections.description: Nuxt.js · Node.js · Supabase · Tailwind CSS · CRM APIs

projects.title: Local Events & Community Platform
projects.shortDescription: A web and mobile platform for publishing local events, managing ticket sales, and discovering nearby activities based on location, interests, and availability.

sections.label: The challenge
sections.description: Local event discovery and organisation often involve separate tools for promotion, ticketing and payments. The goal was to bring these activities together, helping organisers manage their events and making it easier for people to find activities that fit their interests and schedules.

sections.label: My contribution
sections.description: I developed the web platform and a companion mobile app using Flutter, implementing event publishing, ticket management, attendance tracking and location-based discovery. I also integrated banking functionality to support payment workflows. The earlier web implementation used Python and Django on the backend, with Angular and Vue on the frontend; I am planning its migration to Nuxt.js, Express, Node.js and Supabase.

sections.label: How it works
sections.description: Organisers publish local events and projects, manage ticket sales and track attendance. Users browse activities through an interactive map and filter results by location, interests and dates. The web platform and Flutter mobile app provide access to these workflows, with banking integration supporting payments.

sections.label: Key technical challenges
sections.description:
• Location-based discovery: combining interactive map search with filters for interests and dates.
  • Ticket management: coordinating ticket sales and attendance records for each event.
  • Banking integration: connecting payment workflows with event and ticket data.
  • Web and mobile experiences: adapting event discovery and management workflows to browser and mobile interfaces.

sections.label: Product value
sections.description: The platform connects local communities with relevant activities while giving organisers a central place to publish events, manage tickets and track participation. Web and mobile access supports both advance planning and discovery on the go.

sections.label: Technologies
sections.description:
Current implementation: Python · Django · Angular · Vue.js · Flutter · Banking integration
Planned web migration: Nuxt.js · Express · Node.js · Supabase · Tailwind CSS

projects.title: Forensic Report Automation Platform
projects.shortDescription: A configurable document generation platform that transforms structured form submissions into professional Word reports for forensic experts and expert witnesses.

sections.label: The challenge
sections.description: Preparing expert reports involves organising case information, drafting recurring sections and maintaining consistent document formatting. Repeating this work manually takes time and can introduce omissions or inconsistencies across reports.

sections.label: My contribution
sections.description: I developed the document upload and extraction workflow, integrated Claude for AI-assisted processing, and built the interface for reviewing and editing extracted information. I also implemented data persistence with Supabase and contract-specific field mappings for CRM synchronisation.

sections.label: How it works
sections.description: Users enter case information through structured forms. The platform uses the submitted data and configured report structure to assemble a formatted document. Reports can be exported as editable Word documents for further review and refinement.

sections.label: Key technical challenges
sections.description:
• Configurable report structures: supporting different reporting requirements while reusing common sections and generation logic.
  • Data-to-document mapping: placing submitted information into the appropriate report sections and handling optional or missing values.

sections.label: Product value
sections.description: The platform reduces repetitive drafting and formatting work, helping professionals prepare reports more consistently. Word export gives experts the flexibility to refine the content before finalising it.

sections.label: Technologies
sections.description: Nuxt.js · Tailwind CSS · DOCX generation
